title: Real English Conversation 🎧 - Life in the U.S.A. vs Life in Mexico B1

sentences.en: Hello and welcome to my Slow English podcast. Today I will be having a conversation with my sister about the differences between Mexico and the USA. We have both lived in the United States and in Mexico. This is real life conversation practice. No script, just slow English practice. This is for A2 beginner English learners, but I have some challenging questions in this lesson as well. So, pause if you need it and try and answer each question.
sentences.tc: 您好，歡迎來到我的慢速英語播客。今天我將和我姐姐談論墨西哥和美國之間的差異。我們都住在美國和墨西哥。這是現實生活中的對話練習。沒有劇本，只是慢慢練習英文。這是針對 A2 初級英語學習者的，但我在本課中也有一些具有挑戰性的問題。因此，如果需要，請暫停並嘗試回答每個問題。
